beats.text: After a first conversation, people like you more than you think. Seriously!
Researchers paired strangers for a five-minute chat. Then both rated: how much do I like them? And how much do they like me?
People underestimated how much they were liked. Even in longer talks. And with roommates?
So that awkward chat? It went better than you think!

ask: SEND THIS TO SOMEONE YOU JUST MET.
sources: Boothby, Cooney, Sandstrom & Clark (2018), The liking gap in conversations: Do people like us more than we think?, Psychological Science 29(11) – five studies; strangers' 5-minute conversations, longer conversations, real-world settings; gap persisted for months among college roommates.
